title: UPLIFT DESK V3 2-Leg Walnut Laminate Wood Standing Desk – Adjustable Height, Advanced 1-Touch Memory Keypad, Under Desk Cable Management, Wire Grommets & Rocker Board (Black C-Frame, 42 x 30 inch)
features: SEAMLESS ELECTRIC HEIGHT ADJUSTMENT: The Advanced Keypad with one-touch control and four memory presets ensures effortless transitions. This adjustable standing desk lets you switch between sitting and standing to improve posture, circulation, and productivity.

PREMIUM LAMINATE DESKTOP: This industrial desk features symmetrical patterns and consistent colors with a water, stain, and scratch-resistant laminate for lasting durability. The sleek ash gray desk design complements any modern office setup.

DUAL GERMAN MOTORS: Dual German-made motors provide smooth, fast, and quiet adjustments (under 48 dB). Three-stage legs enable 33% faster movement and a greater height range than a standard two-stage lift desk.

STURDY AND DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: The heavy-duty steel frame supports 355 lbs, ensuring rock-solid stability and long-lasting durability. A six-axis gyroscope sensor detects and prevents collisions, with adjustable sensitivity to protect your workspace.
SMART CABLE MANAGEMENT: Keep your office desk clutter-free with the FlexMount Cable Manager and built-in grommets, ensuring efficient cable organization for a tidy, distraction-free setup.
